why: The shopper asked for one product type under a price cap, and ChatGPT answered with five individual inverter cards; it mentioned batteries and panels only to say the prices exclude them, not as items the shopper must add. Battery-bank voltage (24 V vs 48 V), 120/240 V split-phase output, and grid-tie versus off-grid capability decide which inverter fits, which makes this a model comparison that recommends one inverter rather than a set.
